reviewer: Codex visual inspection of final full-character, fixed-camera crops and isolated anatomy PNGs

criteria.reason: Each orange foot skin is one closed connected quad surface with three separate front branches and one rear branch, with four independently editable closed dark claws. Front/back and isolated 3/4 geometry confirm the actual four digits; all 37 unrelated predecessor meshes are preserved.

The rear toe opposes the three front toes behind the bar and curls below it. Profile exposes the complete opposed grip. The 3/4 production crop shows the rear bases; the isolated unchanged-camera toe view resolves the normally occluded tips. Real pad crown support, triangle clipping, nearest-surface contacts and 45 surface collision pairs establish a mechanically supported grip within Blender float tolerance.

Frozen nominal bar/stem/base outside dimensions are retained with rounded quad ends. Compact feet sit naturally on the crown; the simple support remains secondary in all four full-character comparisons. Radius and placement limits are exposed and exercised, with coupled pad height. Gray perch and diagnostic keratin colors are explicit inspection treatments; the separately scheduled #18 lookdev supplies final shaders.

known_boundaries: Final brushed-metal/cyan/keratin lookdev remains the existing #18 goal.
Front-facing bar naturally occludes the lowest rear claw tips; the fixed profile and explicitly isolated 3/4 anatomy views expose them.
Toe groups are anatomical attachments for later rigging, not finished controls.
